summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Compahia Paranaense de Energia (Copel), a Brazilian electric services company, reporting its first quarter 2026 results. The filing contains standard operational and financial highlights, including EBITDA, net income, leverage, and shareholder returns such as interest on equity and dividend payments. No special situation event is present; it is a periodic earnings release with no indication of an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is purely an earnings update with no transactional or structural event warranting special situations classification.
